title: TCL G03 / BeyondTV4 firmware V8-R51MT05-LF1V652 (AR11), reports as "Smart TV Pro", Android TV 11 (SDK 30),
notes:
TCL G03 / BeyondTV4 firmware V8-R51MT05-LF1V652 (AR11), reports as "Smart TV Pro", Android TV 11 (SDK 30),
Google TV launcher (com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx). Same firmware as docs/devices/tcl-75c63b.md.
Tested models:
TCL 43C645, Realtek RTD2851 / R51MT05, Ethernet. Groups 1-3, tested 2026-10-19.
TCL 60C635 (product G03_4K_GB, device BeyondTV4), Realtek rtd288o, 2 GB, security patch 2024-12-05,
Spain, Wi-Fi. Every group except 3, com.tcl.android.webview and com.tcl.keyhelp, plus launcherx,
tested 2026-10-20.
List derived from examples/tcl-65c725 (same Android 11 TCL platform), checked against both units' packages.

43C645: applied in three batches with a screenshot after each: Ethernet stayed up, Home and the D-pad, the
launcher's Sources menu (HDMI via TvInputManager), Netflix, and Home from Netflix all worked, also after a
reboot. Private DNS (AdGuard) kept working. tools/b64push.py failed its md5 check here, plain `adb push` +
`pm install -r` worked.
60C635: batch by batch with a screenshot after each: Home, the Input key (Quick panel), Live TV, HDMI and
YouTube kept working, also after a cold reboot with launcherx off. The remote's app buttons need the
launcher's key services: see README.md, config.json and build-and-install.sh.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-43c645/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-43c645/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
(or examples/tcl-43c645/restore.sh, which also gives Home back to launcherx)
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx. HOME fallback com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith
takes over once it is disabled, so it is disabled too (group 1b). Home then resolves to the new launcher.
build-and-install.sh disables launcherx itself once the new launcher is Home.
Live TV / HDMI: com.tcl.tv (TVActivity) + com.tcl.tvinput (tuner and passthrough input services).
Never disable: com.tcl.providers.config com.tcl.initsetup com.tcl.factory.view com.tcl.system.server
com.tcl.tcl_bt_rcu_service com.tcl.autopair com.tcl.tvinput com.tcl.tv com.tcl.tvpassthrough com.tcl.settings
com.tcl.inputmethod.international com.tcl.sourcemananger com.tcl.keycustomfunctionservice
com.tcl.suspension (Input key / Quick panel) com.google.android.inputmethod.latin com.google.android.gms
com.google.android.gsf com.android.vending
Kept by choice on both: Cast receiver (mediashell), Live TV (com.tcl.tv), screensaver (dreamx).
